claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if humanoid makers standardize on integrated joint torque sensing (no discrete F/T sensor) or Chinese suppliers commoditize the layer without Novanta wins; upgrade when any humanoid maker names ATI/Novanta sensors, or Novanta discloses humanoid-related orders/revenue split.
claims.statement: Novanta (NOVT), via ATI Industrial Automation, officially markets multi-axis force/torque sensors for humanoid robots (compliant grasping, collision detection, adaptive manipulation), plus frameless motors, miniature encoders and servo drives positioned for knee/elbow/wrist integration — giving the graph's force-torque-sensor chokepoint its first named supplier. Limits: vendor self-report application page; no humanoid maker named as customer; prior assessment of this layer notes low substitutability barriers and a multi-supplier market (Sintokogio, SCHUNK, Chinese entrants), so first-named does not mean bottleneck-holder; Novanta humanoid revenue not disclosed (low purity).
